ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    //IsBlank(ProjectTitle_txt.Text) ||
           IsBlank(PriorityChallenge_txt_1.Text) || IsBlank(ProjectGoalDescription_txt_1.Text)
        || IsBlank(KeyDeliverable_txt_1.Text) || IsBlank(AnnualTarget_txt_1.Text) || IsBlank(Reference_txt_1.Text)
        || IsBlank(Budget_txt_1.Text) || IsBlank(ProjectProgramme_drp_1.Selected)
        || IsBlank(ProjectDirectorate_drp_1.Selected)
        || IsBlank(Responsibility_cmb_1.Selected) || IsBlank(ProjectStartDate_pkr_1.SelectedDate)
        || IsBlank(ProjectCompletionDate_pkr_1.SelectedDate) || IsBlank(ProjectFY_drp_1.Selected) || IsBlank(ProjectStatus_drp_1.Selected),

    Notify("All fields are required before saving.", NotificationType.Error),

    Set(
    varSelectedProject,
    Patch(
        Projects,
        If(varMode = "New", Defaults(Projects), varSelectedProject),
        {
            PriorityChallenge: PriorityChallenge_txt_1.Text,
            ProjectGoalDescription: ProjectGoalDescription_txt_1.Text,
            KeyDeliverable: KeyDeliverable_txt_1.Text,
            AnnualTarget: AnnualTarget_txt_1.Text,
            Reference: Reference_txt_1.Text,
            Budget: Value(Budget_txt_1.Text),
            Programme: ProjectProgramme_drp_1.Selected.Title,
            Directorate: Dropdown2.Selected.DirectorateID,
            Responsibility: Responsibility_cmb_1.Selected,
            StartDate: ProjectStartDate_pkr_1.SelectedDate,
            CompletionDate: ProjectCompletionDate_pkr_1.SelectedDate,
            FinancialYear: ProjectFY_drp_1.Selected,
            Status: ProjectStatus_drp_1.Selected
        }
    )
    );
    Set(varMode, "View");
    ClearCollect(
        colProjectsInScope,
        Filter(
            Projects,
            varCanViewAllReports
                || Directorate.Value = varUserDirectorateID
                || Directorate.Value = varUserDirectorate
        )
    );
    Notify("Project saved successfully.", NotificationType.Success)
)

If(
    varMode = "New",
    Blank(),
    LookUp(Directorate, DirectorateID = varSelectedProject.Directorate.Value)
)
